page.overview:
Who is Elise Strang?

Elise's name could indicate Andoran origin (see Kairen Stang, Elisa al'Seen, Elisa al'Vere, and Elise Marwin).

Elise held the position for twenty-one years until her death in the series. She was Catala Lucanvalle's successor and Comarra Zepava's predecessor.

She was such a weak Amyrlin that she had to beg to have what she wanted from the Hall.
